name: Lotame
sells: audience data and Panorama ID identity for advertisers and publishers

optOut.notes: Page describes Lotame's Browser Opt-Out Tool (lotame-optout.com, which returned 403 to an automated fetch on 2026-10-18), industry opt-outs (DAA, NAI), and privacy-rights requests. Lotame says it handles all opt-outs by deleting the relevant data. The mission URL (lotames-products-services-privacy-policy) redirects to lotame.com/privacy/?tab=2.
